title: docs(qa): map every North Star core feature to a checklist item
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_
Part of #35212
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只是平台测试清单里新增了十条测试项，每个北极星核心功能现在都能在清单里找到对应的测试项。
- 为什么做：北极星核心功能与测试清单对齐专题，让每个核心功能都有可执行、可派发的验证依据。
- 出错会怎样：只影响测试清单的内容，不碰任何产品代码；写错的测试项可以直接改或撤回，不影响任何用户。
- 要你做什么：页面首屏加载时间的阈值还没定，需要你定一个数，之后才能为它写测试项。

## What changes

Ten items appended to the platform checklist (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/**`), authored through `checklist-author`, one per core-feature gap: eight `active` (steps, clause-grained acceptance, resolving anchors) and two `planned` (personas, no steps), per the README's one-ledger rule. No other file changes. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is untouched and no second mapping document is created: the mapping below is a reading, delivered here and on the card.

**Mapping — every core feature in the North Star "Product areas" table** (read at `49c8e0f0`; items read in full, not matched on titles):

| Core feature | Item id(s) | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ai 1 · asking for data: right numbers, row/field permissions | ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed, ai.mcp-dataset-tools | covered |
| ai 2 · labels and units, no internal values | **ai.mcp-answer-labels-units-source** | new |
| ai 3 · writes pass permissions and confirmation; overstep stopped, leaves a trace | ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate, access-security.ai-service-account-agent-ceiling, ai.pending-action-held-approval (planned) + **ai.mcp-record-write-permission-and-confirmation** + **ai.agent-overstep-refusal-trace** (planned) | partial, then new: record writes over MCP had no item; a refused agent call writes no audit row today, so the trace is a planned item |
| ai 4 · MCP exposes what the app really can do | ai.mcp-http-surface, ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate, ai.mcp-coded-refusals-and-runtime-exposure, ai.mcp-namespace-faces | covered |
| ai 5 · skills match the platform | **ai.product-skill-claims-gates** | new |
| build 1 · one command creates and runs a project | cli.scaffold-first-run, cli.scaffold-console-first-paint | covered |
| build 2 · wrong metadata loudly refused with a prescription | api-backend.enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates, api-backend.retired-def-refusal, studio-authoring.removed-key-save-door-refusal, studio-authoring.authoring-validation-not-persisted, cli.validate-v18-authoring-verdicts | covered |
| build 3 · Studio builds objects, fields, views, forms, pages | studio-authoring.object-designer-roundtrip, studio-authoring.view-authoring-live, studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip, studio-authoring.custom-page-render-and-blocks | covered |
| build 4 · draft to publish is atomic | studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle | covered |
| data 1 · CRUD, field input, refusal on the spot, master and detail together | records-forms.crud-roundtrip, records-forms.field-type-matrix, records-forms.field-type-constraints, records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix, records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save | covered |
| data 2 · filter, sort, paginate, bulk, search | records-forms.list-view-capabilities, records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder, records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching, api-backend.bulk-write-contract, search.cross-field-object-search, search.console-global-search | covered |
| data 3 · queries, aggregates, reports add up; in the database, not truncated | api-backend.query-contract-matrix, api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix, dashboards.system-overview-live-counts, dashboards.cube-query, dashboards.cross-object-where-engine-path | covered |
| data 4 · row/field permissions both sides; files follow the record | access-security.rls-both-sides, access-security.fls-mask-and-strip, attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls, attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides | covered |
| data 5 · anonymous out; sign-in, recovery, 2FA, revocable sessions | access-security.anonymous-deny-surfaces, identity-auth.auth-method-matrix, identity-auth.self-service-password-reset, identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal (and its three siblings), identity-auth.session-list-revoke | covered |
| data 6 · orgs, members, invitations, SSO, SCIM; audit log; access explained | identity-auth.org-membership-team-management, identity-auth.invitation-scope-gates, identity-auth.auth-method-matrix (SSO/OIDC variant), identity-auth.idp-group-permission-set-mapping, identity-auth.scim-deactivation-revokes-api-keys, access-security.audit-log-browser, access-security.record-access-explain | covered |
| workflow 1 · flows and approvals run to completion | automation.flow-node-type-matrix, automation.trigger-type-matrix, approvals.decision-action-matrix, approvals.per-group-signoff | covered |
| workflow 2 · notifications arrive, scheduled jobs run on time | integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery, platform-core.notification-center, integration-system.job-scheduled-run, automation.time-relative-trigger | covered |
| workflow 3 · the API works as documented | api-backend.query-contract-matrix, api-backend.error-envelope-ledger, api-backend.route-ledger-live-parity, api-backend.api-console-discovery-execute + **api-backend.openapi-paths-answer-live** | partial, then new: nothing held the served OpenAPI document against the live server |
| workflow 4 · external data and connectors plug in; a sync loses nothing | integration-system.connector-declarative-boot, integration-system.external-datasource-federated-read + **integration-system.mapping-pull-sync-lossless** | partial, then new: the mapping pull sync had no item |
| ux 1 · one design system, one layout | records-forms.list-view-capabilities (list frame geometry), records-forms.record-open-path-and-header + **ux-conventions.one-design-system-one-layout** (planned) | partial, then new: no oracle reads the other page kinds today |
| ux 2 · every write gives feedback | ux-conventions.write-feedback | covered |
| ux 3 · errors speak plainly and give the reason | ux-conventions.write-feedback, ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason, records-forms.script-action-hook-refusal-toast | covered |
| ux 4 · main operations on a phone | **ux-conventions.phone-main-operations** | new |
| ux 5 · a Chinese interface shows no stray English | i18n.surface-matrix, i18n.studio-follows-app-locale | covered |
| ux 6 · first screen within an acceptable time (threshold to be set) | none | **gap, out of scope here**: not a checklist capability until a threshold exists; no card filed (the maintainer ordered no new cards on 2026-11-25) |
| package 1 · install, enable, disable, uninstall; disabled, every surface agrees | platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable, platform-core.manifest-install-contract, api-backend.package-rest-lifecycle + **platform-core.disabled-package-every-surface-agrees** | partial, then new: MCP and global search were not read after a disable |
| package 2 · seed data lands as written | platform-core.seed-integrity, platform-core.seed-mode-matrix | covered |
| package 3 · an upgrade shows its plan first, loses no data | cli.package-upgrade-plan-override-advice, cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json, cli.migrate-plan-apply-json | covered (see acceptance notes) |
| package 4 · release notes; a breaking change has a migration guide | **platform-core.release-notes-and-migration-guide-gates** | new |

Totals: 29 core features; 19 covered, 5 partial now closed by a new item, 4 new, 1 gap (ux 6). Ten items authored, under the 12-item budget. `Part of`, not `Fixes`: ux 6 stays open on #35212, out of scope for this PR; no card is filed for it (the maintainer ordered no new cards on 2026-11-25).

## Tests

`pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 0 on head `0a8e7eb8f8`; the anchor count rose by 38 and every new anchor resolves (1801/1811 resolved, the same 10 on the named residual as on `main`).

<details><summary>check:platform-checklist tail at 0a8e7eb8f8</summary>

```text
check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 447 items (436 active, 5 planned); coverage: 40 kinds mapped, 4 waived; traps: 19 documented, 19 in use; provisioning: 10 area recipes, 18 item references resolved (5 area-qualified), 10/10 recipes referenced; ... symbol anchors: 1801/1811 resolved by `symbol-anchors.mjs` (the ONE resolver, reached as a REGISTERED corpus) across 21 swept documents against 692 cited sources, 10 on the named #16898 residual, 18 file floors held
```

Baseline on `main` at `49c8e0f0`: 437 items (428 active, 3 planned), 1763/1773 anchors resolved.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, 17), run locally at 0a8e7eb8f8</summary>

All 17 exit 0: check-adr-links (and --self-test), check-closing-keyword-parity (and --self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, plan-test-core-shards --self-test, lint check:doc-formula-expressions, check:adr-anchors, check:ci-filter-parity, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:doc-authoring, check:driver-memory-census, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:platform-checklist, check:refd-timer-probe, check:watch-hint-literal. Six first answered exit 3 (prerequisite: no node_modules, then an unbuilt formula and lint package) and were re-run green after install and a locked build. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 17 of 17 accounted for.
</details>

No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour (ledger content only).

## Acceptance notes

- The eight `active` items are read from source at `49c8e0f0`; no live run was made, so each history row says so. Their first run is a `checklist-test` round.
- integration-system.mapping-pull-sync-lossless needs a scratch app: the showcase declares no mapping with a connectorSource.
- package 3: no clause re-reads rows after a confirmed, applied upgrade. The existing items verify the plan, the dry run and the confirmation stop on a destructive change. I left it as an observation, not an item.
- ai 3: the action audit row is written only for calls that cleared the admission gates, so a refused agent call leaves no row. This is a missing capability, recorded as the planned item, not a defect.
- `planned` items are not coverage (README): ai.agent-overstep-refusal-trace and ux-conventions.one-design-system-one-layout map their features without claiming they are verified.

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `areas/ai.json` (the two MCP items cite the most mechanism), `areas/integration-system.json` (the sync item's fixture is a scratch app), `areas/platform-core.json`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm check:platform-checklist` in the branch. Expect `OK — 16 areas, 447 items (436 active, 5 planned)` and `1801/1811` anchors resolved.
